#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Demo (csr mode): CSR insn-match switching on the RVV GEMM workload.
#
# Profiles a KERNEL chosen by csrwi 0x7C0,{0,1} markers in the source. Walks
# one QEMU1 -> vsim -> QEMU2 round-trip on rt_c_v_matmul (16x16x16 RVV GEMM):
# QEMU1 seeds A/B, vsim runs the vmatmul_kernel between the markers (the
# measured window), QEMU2 verifies. This is the default switching path a user
# gets out of the box.
#
# Honors all the same env overrides as e2e.sh (VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU,
# VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM, TIMEOUT).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)

MODE_LABEL="CSR mode (profiles a kernel)"
echo "=========================================================="
echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
echo "Fixture: rt_c_v_matmul (RVV 16x16x16 GEMM)"
echo "Trigger: csrwi 0x7C0, 0 (enter) -> csrwi 0x7C0, 1 (exit)"
echo "=========================================================="

set +e
FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul TRIGGER_MODE=csr EXPECT_RC=0 TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}" \
  bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/../e2e.sh"
RC=$?
set -e

if [ "$RC" -eq 77 ]; then
  echo "[demo csr] SKIP (artifacts missing)"
  exit 77
fi

if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "[demo csr] FAIL ($MODE_LABEL): underlying harness exit $RC"
  exit "$RC"
fi

echo "[demo csr] PASS ($MODE_LABEL)"

2	# End-to-end roundtrip harness: QEMU 1 + plugin -> vsim -> QEMU 2.
3	#
4	# Memory between QEMU and vsim is shared via an /dev/shm-backed mmap
5	# (128 MB). Works for both asm fixtures (handoff_roundtrip, rt_*) and
6	# C-level fixtures (rt_c_*). C fixtures require shared mmap so the
7	# stack/heap survives handoffs; asm fixtures don't need it but run
8	# fine with it.
9	#
10	# Env:
11	#   FIXTURE         REQUIRED. .elf name under tests/fixtures/ (no .elf suffix).
12	#   EXPECT_RC       Final exit code to assert (default 0).
13	#   TRIGGER_MODE    csr | pc (default csr).
14	#   ROI_START       pc mode only. Switch-in PC: a 0x address or a symbol in
15	#                   $VSIM_ELF (default: _hybrid_enter_pc).
16	#   ROI_END         pc mode only. Switch-out PC, same forms
17	#                   (default: _hybrid_exit_pc).
18	#   TIMEOUT         vsim leg timeout in seconds (default 60).
19	#   CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC=1   assert mcycle/minstret strictly increased
20	#                              between QEMU 1's drain and vsim's drain.
21	#   VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM  override built paths.
22	
23	set -euo pipefail
24	
25	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
26	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/paths.sh"
27	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/roi.sh"
28	
29	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:?FIXTURE env var is required (e.g. FIXTURE=rt_c_hello)}"
30	EXPECT_RC="${EXPECT_RC:-0}"
31	TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-60}"
32	TRIGGER_MODE="${TRIGGER_MODE:-csr}"
33	
34	hybrid_resolve_paths
35	
36	NM="${NM:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}}"
37	NM="${NM:-riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}"
38	
39	case "$TRIGGER_MODE" in
40	  csr) ;;
41	  pc)
42	    if ! command -v "$NM" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
43	      echo "skip[$FIXTURE pc]: nm not found at $NM"
44	      exit 77
45	    fi
46	    NM_OUT=$("$NM" --defined-only "$VSIM_ELF")
47	    # ROI_START / ROI_END (env) name the two switch PCs: each is a 0x address
48	    # or a symbol in $VSIM_ELF. Default to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
49	    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers, so existing fixtures need no change.
50	    roi_resolve_pair "$NM_OUT" "$FIXTURE pc" || exit 1
51	    ;;
52	  *)
53	    echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: unknown TRIGGER_MODE=$TRIGGER_MODE (use csr|pc)"
54	    exit 1
55	    ;;
56	esac
57	
58	# 128 MB matches the QEMU virt machine default; vsim uses the same size.
59	SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
60	SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX)
61	STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
62	STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
63	SIM_LOG=$(mktemp)
64	trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM" "$SIM_LOG"' EXIT
65	truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"
66	
67	PLUGIN_ARGS="outfile=$STATE_QEMU"
68	VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=()
69	if [ "$TRIGGER_MODE" = "pc" ]; then
70	  PLUGIN_ARGS="$PLUGIN_ARGS,enter_pc=0x$ENTER_PC"
71	  VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=(--hybrid-exit-pc "0x$EXIT_PC")
72	fi
73	
74	echo "[$FIXTURE 1/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] QEMU 1: drain entry state"
75	set +e
76	"$VSIM_QEMU" \
77	  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
78	  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
79	  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
80	  -nographic \
81	  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
82	  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
83	  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,$PLUGIN_ARGS" >/dev/null 2>&1
84	QEMU1_RC=$?
85	set -e
86	
87	if [ "$QEMU1_RC" -ne 200 ]; then
88	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
89	  exit 1
90	fi
91	
92	if [ ! -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
93	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 did not produce state"
94	  exit 1
95	fi
96	
97	echo "[$FIXTURE 2/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] vsim: resume + drain + spawn QEMU 2"
98	set +e
99	timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
100	  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
101	  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
102	  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
103	  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
104	  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 \
105	  --qemu-binary "$VSIM_QEMU" \
106	  "${VSIM_TRIG_ARGS[@]}" >"$SIM_LOG" 2>&1
107	RC=$?
108	set -e
109	
110	# Kernel cycles (always) + opt-in monotonic check. Offsets locked by
111	# state_abi_check.h (mcycle@624, minstret@632). vsim restores mcycle from
112	# QEMU 1's drain then counts real clock cycles, so vsim_mcycle - qemu1_mcycle
113	# is the measured region's cycle count. Runs before the RC gate so the
114	# verdict is independent of any downstream-phase failure.
115	if [ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ] && [ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
116	  read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
117	  Q1_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le 624 "$STATE_QEMU")
118	  Q1_MINST=$(read_u64_le  632 "$STATE_QEMU")
119	  V_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le  624 "$STATE_VSIM")
120	  V_MINST=$(read_u64_le   632 "$STATE_VSIM")
121	  echo "[$FIXTURE kernel_cycles] $((V_MCYCLE - Q1_MCYCLE))  (vsim mcycle=$V_MCYCLE - qemu1 mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE)"
122	  if [ "${CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC:-0}" = "1" ]; then
123	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] qemu1: mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE minstret=$Q1_MINST"
124	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] vsim:  mcycle=$V_MCYCLE minstret=$V_MINST"
125	    if [ "$V_MCYCLE" -le "$Q1_MCYCLE" ]; then
126	      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: mcycle not strictly increasing across vsim"
127	      exit 1
128	    fi
129	    if [ "$V_MINST" -le "$Q1_MINST" ]; then
130	      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: minstret not strictly increasing across vsim"
131	      exit 1
132	    fi
133	    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] PASS: strictly increasing"
134	  fi
135	fi
136	
137	if [ "$RC" != "$EXPECT_RC" ]; then
138	  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: expected exit $EXPECT_RC, got $RC"
139	  echo "--- sim log ---"
140	  cat "$SIM_LOG"
141	  exit 1
142	fi
143	
144	echo "[$FIXTURE 3/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] PASS: round-trip exit code $RC"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# End-to-end roundtrip harness: QEMU 1 + plugin -> vsim -> QEMU 2.
#
# Memory between QEMU and vsim is shared via an /dev/shm-backed mmap
# (128 MB). Works for both asm fixtures (handoff_roundtrip, rt_*) and
# C-level fixtures (rt_c_*). C fixtures require shared mmap so the
# stack/heap survives handoffs; asm fixtures don't need it but run
# fine with it.
#
# Env:
#   FIXTURE         REQUIRED. .elf name under tests/fixtures/ (no .elf suffix).
#   EXPECT_RC       Final exit code to assert (default 0).
#   TRIGGER_MODE    csr | pc (default csr).
#   ROI_START       pc mode only. Switch-in PC: a 0x address or a symbol in
#                   $VSIM_ELF (default: _hybrid_enter_pc).
#   ROI_END         pc mode only. Switch-out PC, same forms
#                   (default: _hybrid_exit_pc).
#   TIMEOUT         vsim leg timeout in seconds (default 60).
#   CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC=1   assert mcycle/minstret strictly increased
#                              between QEMU 1's drain and vsim's drain.
#   VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM  override built paths.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/roi.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:?FIXTURE env var is required (e.g. FIXTURE=rt_c_hello)}"
EXPECT_RC="${EXPECT_RC:-0}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-60}"
TRIGGER_MODE="${TRIGGER_MODE:-csr}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

NM="${NM:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}}"
NM="${NM:-riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}"

case "$TRIGGER_MODE" in
  csr) ;;
  pc)
    if ! command -v "$NM" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "skip[$FIXTURE pc]: nm not found at $NM"
      exit 77
    fi
    NM_OUT=$("$NM" --defined-only "$VSIM_ELF")
    # ROI_START / ROI_END (env) name the two switch PCs: each is a 0x address
    # or a symbol in $VSIM_ELF. Default to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers, so existing fixtures need no change.
    roi_resolve_pair "$NM_OUT" "$FIXTURE pc" || exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: unknown TRIGGER_MODE=$TRIGGER_MODE (use csr|pc)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# 128 MB matches the QEMU virt machine default; vsim uses the same size.
SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
SIM_LOG=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM" "$SIM_LOG"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

PLUGIN_ARGS="outfile=$STATE_QEMU"
VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=()
if [ "$TRIGGER_MODE" = "pc" ]; then
  PLUGIN_ARGS="$PLUGIN_ARGS,enter_pc=0x$ENTER_PC"
  VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=(--hybrid-exit-pc "0x$EXIT_PC")
fi

echo "[$FIXTURE 1/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] QEMU 1: drain entry state"
set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,$PLUGIN_ARGS" >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e

if [ "$QEMU1_RC" -ne 200 ]; then
  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: QEMU 1 did not produce state"
  exit 1
fi

echo "[$FIXTURE 2/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] vsim: resume + drain + spawn QEMU 2"
set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 \
  --qemu-binary "$VSIM_QEMU" \
  "${VSIM_TRIG_ARGS[@]}" >"$SIM_LOG" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e

# Kernel cycles (always) + opt-in monotonic check. Offsets locked by
# state_abi_check.h (mcycle@624, minstret@632). vsim restores mcycle from
# QEMU 1's drain then counts real clock cycles, so vsim_mcycle - qemu1_mcycle
# is the measured region's cycle count. Runs before the RC gate so the
# verdict is independent of any downstream-phase failure.
if [ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ] && [ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]; then
  read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
  Q1_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le 624 "$STATE_QEMU")
  Q1_MINST=$(read_u64_le  632 "$STATE_QEMU")
  V_MCYCLE=$(read_u64_le  624 "$STATE_VSIM")
  V_MINST=$(read_u64_le   632 "$STATE_VSIM")
  echo "[$FIXTURE kernel_cycles] $((V_MCYCLE - Q1_MCYCLE))  (vsim mcycle=$V_MCYCLE - qemu1 mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE)"
  if [ "${CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] qemu1: mcycle=$Q1_MCYCLE minstret=$Q1_MINST"
    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] vsim:  mcycle=$V_MCYCLE minstret=$V_MINST"
    if [ "$V_MCYCLE" -le "$Q1_MCYCLE" ]; then
      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: mcycle not strictly increasing across vsim"
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$V_MINST" -le "$Q1_MINST" ]; then
      echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: minstret not strictly increasing across vsim"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "[$FIXTURE mcycle/minstret] PASS: strictly increasing"
  fi
fi

if [ "$RC" != "$EXPECT_RC" ]; then
  echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: expected exit $EXPECT_RC, got $RC"
  echo "--- sim log ---"
  cat "$SIM_LOG"
  exit 1
fi

echo "[$FIXTURE 3/3 mode=$TRIGGER_MODE] PASS: round-trip exit code $RC"

# `./hsim demo csr_oneshot` end-to-end

## 1. Dispatch
- `./hsim demo csr_oneshot` -> `tests/fixtures/demo.sh` row `"T1|demo_csr_oneshot.sh"` -> runs `tests/demos/demo_csr_oneshot.sh`.
- That script just sets env and calls `tests/e2e.sh`:
  - `FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul`
  - `TRIGGER_MODE=csr`
  - `EXPECT_RC=0`
  - `TIMEOUT=120`

## 2. Shared mmap setup (`tests/e2e.sh`)
- Allocates `/dev/shm/vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX` of 128 MB, `truncate`d to size.
- Three temp files: `STATE_QEMU` (drain blob), `STATE_VSIM` (drain blob), `SIM_LOG`.
- This shared file is the DRAM image; both QEMUs and vsim mmap it as the AE350 main memory so `.bss`/heap/stack survive across legs.

## 3. Phase 1 - QEMU1 (functional, fast)
- `qemu-system-riscv64 -M andes_ae350 -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512` with the shared mmap as memory backend, ELF as `-bios`, plugin `libhybrid_handoff.so,outfile=$STATE_QEMU`.
- `main()` runs `init_matrices()`: vectorized `vid.v + vadd.vx + vrem.vx + vse32.v` seeds A and B in `.bss` (located inside the shared mmap).
- `enter_vsim()` macro emits the entry marker `csrwi 0x7C0, 0`.
- The TCG plugin (`qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c`) pattern-matches that csrwi at retire, drains the full architectural state (32 GPRs, 32 FPRs, M-mode CSRs, PMP, V block including v0..v31 via `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX=64` per reg) into `hybrid_state_v1` at `$STATE_QEMU`, then exits with rc=200.
- Harness asserts rc==200 and `$STATE_QEMU` non-empty.

## 4. Phase 2 - vsim (cycle-accurate, slow)
- Launches `sim_ax45mpv_premium` with `--resume-from-qemu`, `--handoff-out`, `--shared-mem-path` (same `/dev/shm` file), `--qemu-binary` (for handback).
- `handoff_controller` halts hart via DMI, hands `STATE_QEMU` to `ResumeDriver`:
  - Stage v0..v31 bytes into the V-scratch region at GPA `0x00FF0000` in shared mmap.
  - Restore `mstatus.VS`, then PB sweep `vsetvl e8/m1 + vle8.v v0..v31` from scratch.
  - PB `vsetvl x0, x5, x6` to atomically restore `vtype`+`vl`.
  - Abstract-cmd restore `vstart`, `vxsat`, `vxrm`, `vcsr`, `mstatus`, `mtvec`, `mcycle`, `minstret`, FPRs, GPRs.
- Hart resumes at the instruction after the entry marker.
- Runs `vmatmul_kernel()` (outer-product GEMM: per row, `vmv.v.x 0 -> N x vmacc.vx -> vse32.v`) -- this is the measured window.
- `exit_vsim()` emits `csrwi 0x7C0, 1`. Trigger detector halts the hart.
- `StateDrain` reads back all CSRs/GPRs/FPRs/V-CSRs/mcycle/minstret via Abstract Commands, then last issues the `vse8.v` PB sweep dumping v0..v31 into scratch; writes `hybrid_state_v1` to `$STATE_VSIM`.

## 5. Cycle accounting
- Before checking RC, harness `od`-reads offsets 624 (`mcycle`) and 632 (`minstret`) from both blobs, prints `kernel_cycles = vsim_mcycle - qemu1_mcycle`. Kernel-window cycle count.

## 6. Phase 3 - QEMU2 (functional, finish + verify)
- vsim's `qemu_handback` spawns a second `qemu-system-riscv64` with the SAME shared mmap (so A/B/C are intact) and NO `-kernel` (memory already has the program).
- Connects via gdbstub, sends P-packet writes for every GPR/FPR/CSR/V-reg (including the full M-mode set + PMP that vsim never touched), pulls v0..v31 back from scratch, then `continue`s.
- Hart resumes after the exit marker. `scalar_matmul_verify()` recomputes A*B in pure C and cell-compares against C left by vsim. Prints `rt_c_v_matmul: PASS` or `FAIL`, exits 0/1.

## 7. Verdict
- `e2e.sh` asserts vsim's exit RC equals `EXPECT_RC=0`, then prints `[rt_c_v_matmul 3/3 mode=csr] PASS`.
- `demo_csr_oneshot.sh` translates rc=77 to SKIP, rc=0 to `[demo csr] PASS`, anything else to FAIL.

The wire format moving between the three legs is `hybrid_state_v1` defined in `include/hybrid/state_abi.h`; the kernel source is `tests/fixtures/rt_c_v_matmul.c:81 vmatmul_kernel()`.

content.text:
`--handoff-out <file>` is the vsim drain destination -- where the cycle-accurate leg writes its `hybrid_state_v1` blob when the exit trigger fires.

Specifically:
- vsim runs until the exit condition retires:
  - csr mode: `csrwi 0x7C0, 1`
  - pc mode: `--hybrid-exit-pc 0xADDR`
  - icount mode: `--hybrid-icount N` insns committed
- On that event `StateDrain` halts the hart and dumps GPRs/FPRs/CSRs/V-state into the file at this path.
- vsim then exits with rc 200 (mirrors QEMU1's plugin convention).
- The harness reads `mcycle`/`minstret` from offsets 624/632 of this file to compute `kernel_cycles = vsim_mcycle - qemu1_mcycle`.
- If `--qemu-binary` is also set, the same drained struct is fed to QEMU2 over gdbstub before vsim returns.

Without `--handoff-out`, vsim still runs but produces no state file, so neither the cycle accounting nor the QEMU2 handback can proceed -- `e2e.sh` always passes it (`main.cpp:111`, used at `tests/e2e.sh:101`).
